answer: Agro-robotic networks mitigate Sybil attacks by tying agent identities to optical canopy mapping of yarrow fields along a calibrated spiral path. Nodes authenticate by cross-referencing shadow projections relative to the solar zenith, forcing an attacker to incur the verifiable capital cost of deploying discrete aerial hardware and sensors per identity. However, shifting overcast conditions perturb ambient illumination, occasionally rejecting legitimate nodes.
